summary: This note describes the Minister of Railways, the head of India's Ministry of Railways, who usually holds cabinet rank and is responsible for Indian Railways, one of the world's largest employers. A key duty is presenting the Railway Budget, the Annual Financial Statement of Indian Railways, in Parliament. The note names Piyush Goyal of the Bharatiya Janata Party as the current minister, serving since 3 September 2017.
one_line: Overview of the Minister of Railways, head of India's Ministry of Railways responsible for Indian Railways and its annual Railway Budget.
key_facts: The Minister of Railways is the head of the Ministry of Railways of the Government of India.
The railway minister is usually accorded a cabinet rank.
The Minister of Railways is responsible for Indian Railways.
Indian Railways is described as one of the largest employers in the world.
An important responsibility of the railway minister is to present the Railway Budget in Parliament.
The Railway Budget is the Annual Financial Statement of Indian Railways.
Piyush Goyal of the Bharatiya Janata Party is the current Minister of Railways.
Piyush Goyal has served as Minister of Railways since 3 September 2017.
